title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budge

translated_title: X-split Argus：学习可复用历史令牌以实现高效CTR预测
translated_abstract: 准确的点击率（CTR）预测依赖于能够同时捕捉用户持久偏好和近期意图的用户表示，然而在生产环境的计算和延迟约束下，为每次排序请求处理庞大的行为历史序列代价高昂。我们提出X-split ARGUS，一个用于广告排序的框架，其历史压缩器和在线排序器进行端到端联合训练。压缩器将过往交互编码为一组紧凑的令牌，这些令牌离线计算并在各候选广告间复用；而在线排序器通过对这些令牌和近期事件表示进行交叉注意力来为广告打分。训练过程结合了针对点击反馈的自回归损失，以及从一个更大的教师模型对候选特定点击logits的蒸馏，该教师模型使用未压缩的历史对每个候选进行打分。压缩历史令牌的数量和近期历史的长度均可调整，以适应线上服务的计算和延迟预算。
tldr: 提出X-split ARGUS端到端训练框架，将用户行为历史离线压缩为可复用令牌并结合教师蒸馏，在大幅降低在线计算与延迟成本的同时实现准确的CTR预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes X-split ARGUS, an end-to-end trained framework that compresses user behavioral histories into reusable offline tokens combined with teacher distillation, enabling accurate CTR prediction at significantly reduced online serving cost and latency.
